action_order: lexicographic inputs then increasing scheduled duration; indices zero-based
reward_observation: post-transition state on every executed plant step; no x(0) occupancy credit
update_expenditure: one at start of each executed hold, including the first; no update at/after termination
held_input: hold the selected input unchanged at every executed plant step, redraw plant stochastic rules independently each step

float_policy.save_precision: lossless arrays and full-precision JSON numbers

seeds.engine: NumPy SeedSequence with PCG64; actual NumPy version and generator state recorded at execution
seeds.budget_code: round(1000*Gamma), use zero for evaluation plant/reset tapes and unconstrained references
seeds.common_random_numbers: Plant/reset evaluation keys set method_code=0 and budget_code=0; per training-seed block and rollout they are shared across methods/budgets. Actor action draws use method-specific keys.
seeds.tape_rule: At each plant time reserve one uniform per stochastic coordinate in a fixed node order, even when intervention bypasses a draw; lactose reserves draws for nodes 5 and 9; melanoma reserves one draw for every node. Reset has an independent key. Store seed key plus tape hash.
seeds.terminal_identity: The final checkpoint uses endpoint purpose codes and endpoint key (checkpoint coordinate zero); do not generate a second endpoint record.
seeds.tuning: No tuning in v1; debug purpose 10 and seed labels 900–909 only. Debug results cannot enter active comparisons.
seeds.training_seed_label_note: Labels 0–9 are not direct historical RNG streams. Full key determines the new stream.
seeds.integer_seed_mapping: For an integer-seeded library, form int(SeedSequence(entropy_key).generate_state(1,dtype=np.uint64)[0]) % (2**63). Save the derived integer and full key. Torch initialization uses torch.manual_seed(integer); stdlib Random uses Random(integer). Neither uses an unrecorded global seed.
seeds.categorical_draw_rule: One U in [0,1) per declared plant/action draw. Select the first canonical ordered category whose cumulative probability is strictly greater than U; validate probabilities before sampling. Four-state plant tapes reserve one categorical draw per executed plant step.

aggregation.learned_primary_unit: independently trained policy/run label; nested rollouts are not extra training replications
aggregation.sd: sample SD with ddof=1 across seedwise estimates
aggregation.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap resampling whole training-seed blocks with replacement; use same indices for paired within-study contrasts
aggregation.quantile: linear interpolation h=(n-1)*q, between adjacent sorted values
aggregation.finite_horizon_rate: sum(K)/sum(T) within a seed; T=H in persistent-horizon studies
aggregation.first_arrival_rate: sum(K)/sum(T_cap), including zero/zero initially targeted episodes in totals, not as per-episode ratios
aggregation.rate_across_seeds: mean of seedwise ratios; separately retain pooled ratio of all totals, do not conflate
aggregation.zero_denominator: null with explicit reason, never 0/0=0 or NaN
aggregation.fixed_policy_uncertainty: rollout population SD ddof=0, plus separately labelled rollout-bootstrap mean interval; not a trained-seed SD
aggregation.exact_reference_uncertainty: none; numerical solver residuals, not sampling error
aggregation.feasibility: flag each seed and displayed aggregate against declared tolerance; separately report fraction of feasible training seeds; no confidence guarantee
aggregation.fixed_first_arrival_bootstrap: resample within each initial-state stratum, preserve equal state weights; do not randomize the stratified initial distribution

acceptance.required: correct identities, legal actions, documented config, preserved input hashes, complete finite raw records, declared residual tests; no fabricated missing seeds
acceptance.budget_violation: a scientific outcome to report, not reason to discard/reseed/retrain
acceptance.diagnostic_residual_above_threshold: report not near-stationary at recorded endpoint; retain the run. Do not extend/tune silently
acceptance.runtime_nonfinite: mark failed, retain logs/config/seed; changing algorithm requires versioned amendment
acceptance.solver_failure: block exact-optimum claim; retain failure and diagnostics; do not substitute historic optimum

timing.profile: CPU-only sequential workers; torch and BLAS threads=1; record all effective thread settings
timing.include: record hardware model, logical/physical cores, RAM, OS, Python/package versions, accelerator use, determinism flags, process isolation and source commit/hash
timing.reruns: Do not repeat timings and retain only favorable ones. Any timed repetition plan requires a versioned config.

protocol_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps({"study": full_study_config, "common": full_common_config, "comparator_definitions": used_definition_map}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
protocol_identity.activation: A later execution authorization/preflight record references the frozen declared protocol protocol hash; declared protocol execution_allowed=false is not rewritten. Material semantic changes require a new protocol version.
